articles.title: Lesser-tracked bitcoin market dynamic lends credibility to August surge to $80,000

articles.title: Japan to start stocks and bonds tokenization development plans this year

articles.title: A massive $6.4 billion bitcoin options expiry on Friday could amplify volatility
